title: Widespread recurrence needs attention from prefrontal cortex

statements.text: Visual cortex alone does not reach the global stage: widespread recurrent processing needs attention, which depends on interactions between visual and prefrontal cortex. On this point the theory is closer to global workspace theory than its definitions suggest.

sources.quote: According to RPT, widespread recurrent processing requires attention, and for this, interactions between the visual cortex and prefrontal areas are deemed necessary.
RPT is more compatible with GNWT than their different definitions would suggest
